title: auth: from_file takes &str path, should take &Path or impl AsRef<Path>
description: crates/auth/src/store.rs line 155: pub fn from_file(path: &str) -> Result<Self, String>. Idiomatic Rust for file-path arguments is &Path or impl AsRef<Path>. Using &str forces callers to convert OsStr/Path to &str (with possible UTF-8 failure) before calling. The same applies to merge_from_file(path: &str) on line 176. The label parameter in from_content/merge_from_content is used for error messages only, not as a path, so &str is appropriate there.
notes: Fix: change from_file(path: &str) to from_file(path: &Path) and from_file(path: impl AsRef<Path>). Update the internal std::fs::read_to_string call (already takes &Path). The call site in server_stores.rs passes a &str from config, which would need .as_ref() or Path::new(). merge_from_file same change.
